description: Register a webhook URL to receive notifications when a model's price changes by more than a specified percentage. Optionally scope the alert to a specific provider or model. Returns the alert ID.

model_name.description: Limit to a specific model name. Omit for all models.

provider.description: Limit to a specific provider (e.g. 'openai'). Omit for all.

threshold_pct.description: Minimum absolute % price change to trigger the alert (default: 5.0)

url.description: Webhook URL to POST when the alert fires

name: register_price_alert
